Question_text: Which is a vector quantity?
Forces of 4.0 N and 2.0 N act at a point. Which scale diagram shows the forces that have a resultant of 4.0 N?
image: Four diagrams (A, B, C, D) showing different vector additions of a 2.0 N force and a 4.0 N force. Diagram A shows the forces almost perpendicular, forming a parallelogram. Diagram B shows forces at an acute angle, forming a parallelogram. Diagram C shows forces at an obtuse angle, forming a parallelogram. Diagram D shows two forces in opposite directions along the same line, one 2.0N to the left and one 4.0N to the right, both originating from the same point, resulting in a net force of 2.0 N to the right. The correct diagram for a resultant of 4.0 N with forces of 4.0 N and 2.0 N acting at a point would typically involve a parallelogram where the diagonal is 4.0 N; option C visually depicts a situation where the resultant could be 4.0 N (e.g., if the 2N and 4N forces are almost in the same direction, with an angle between them).
